steps.code:
# I need to reorganize from "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>" to "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>"
# Let me parse each file and create the necessary directories, then move the files
import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings/"
for file_path in files:
    # Extract the filename from the full path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    # Split the name by "__" to get date and file_name
    parts = name.split("__")
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date, file_name = parts
        # Create directory for file_name
        dir_path = base_dir + file_name + "/"
        create_result = apis.file_system.create_directory(
            access_token=access_token,
            directory_path=dir_path,
            recursive=True
        )
        print(f"Create dir {dir_path}: {create_result}")
        # Move the file to the new location
        dest_path = dir_path + date + ext
        move_result = apis.file_system.move_file(
            access_token=access_token,
            source_file_path=file_path,
            destination_file_path=dest_path
        )
        print(f"Move {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {move_result}")
